findings.summary: The page covers the current configuration model only; the v1.1 allowlist/placement/verbosity settings do not yet exist and are owned by later tasks.
findings.detail: ADR-016 clause 2 and the task Work bullet name 'the v1.1 allowlist/placement/verbosity settings' and 'the settings surface the later v1.1 goals add'. Those fields are absent from PluginConfiguration/RendererConfiguration/BadgeSelectorConfiguration, and the phase plan explicitly assigns exposing them to Phase 10 (ADR-020 verbosity) and Phase 12 (ADR-017 allowlist / ADR-019 placement) tasks, which say 'Expose it through the ADR-016 settings page'. The page cannot edit a non-existent property without inventing configuration, and the worker recorded this as a deliberate, documented scope decision in PLANS.md 9.2 and docs/changelog.md rather than silently dropping it. The PageFieldsCoverEveryUserAdjustableConfigurationProperty test reflects the current model and will force the page to be extended when those properties land.
evidence: PLANS.md task 9.2 Status and Phase 10/12 task definitions
findings.recommended_action: No action for 9.2. Later tasks 10.x/12.x must extend the page and the coverage test will enforce it.

findings.summary: The two host-guarded DashboardController facts are skipped in this environment; live dashboard appearance and route/authorization behavior are deferred to the plan's task 14.3.
findings.detail: ARRTAGS_JELLYFIN_HOST_DIR is unset and no Jellyfin.Api.dll exists on this machine, so PinnedDashboardControllerServesTheArrTagsSettingsPage and PinnedDashboardControllerPageResourceIsAnonymousAndTheListIsElevationGated are skipped, exactly as the JellyfinHostFactAttribute documents (skip when unset, fail when set but the assembly is missing). The task acceptance criterion 'the page-resource authorization behavior is confirmed' is satisfied by the explicit decision in ADR-016 clause 6 (recorded in docs/architecture.md section 6), which ADR-016 clause 7 second bullet accepts as an alternative to live-host confirmation; the static pinned-source evidence is in docs/research/jellyfin-12-architecture.md 9.1. PLANS.md 'Phase-transition criterion' and Gate 9 explicitly state goal acceptance criteria are met at the integration-test level and consolidated live confirmation is owned by task 14.3.
findings.recommended_action: No action for 9.2. Task 14.3 owns the live pinned-host confirmation.

findings.summary: The model-coverage test asserts property-name presence, not that each field is both read and written.
findings.detail: PageFieldsCoverEveryUserAdjustableConfigurationProperty only requires each public settable configuration property name to appear as a word somewhere in the page source; a property present only in a description would still pass. The reviewer independently reproduced the worker's non-vacuity claim (replacing all QueueCapacity tokens failed the coverage fact with OperationalLimits.QueueCapacity missing) and a companion fact (renaming only the save-side reference failed PageOnlyReferencesKnownConfigurationProperties). Manual inspection confirms every field is in fact both populated on pageshow and written on submit, so the weakness is not currently masking a defect. This is a test-strength observation, not a correctness defect.
evidence: reviewer falsification runs: Failed 1, Passed 5, Skipped 2 in both experiments
findings.recommended_action: No change required. A future hardening could assert per-field read+write, but the current coverage is non-vacuous and the fields are verified by inspection.

findings.summary: The page echoes the API-returned secrets into password inputs; this is within ADR-016 clause 2 and remains subject to the task's separate security review.
findings.detail: The three secret inputs (sonarrApiKey, radarrApiKey, webhookSecret) are type=password with no embedded value; the pageshow handler assigns the value returned by ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration. That is the same administrator-gated value the existing configuration API already returns, which ADR-016 clause 2 explicitly permits ('exposes no secret value beyond what Jellyfin's existing administrator configuration API already returns'). No secret literal is embedded (reviewer grep found only the public plugin GUID as a long token; the sentinel test passes). Task 9.2's Review field is security-reviewer, which is a separate gate owned by the orchestrator.
findings.recommended_action: No action for the implementation review; the security-reviewer gate still applies.
